# WO-2026-08-13-03 — Cockpit a human can actually use

## Acceptance criteria

> **⛔ WARWICK'S TEST, and it is the whole order.** *"The normal Cockpit experience must be HUMAN-READABLE,
> RELEVANT, INFORMATIVE, **NOT A DATABASE VIEW**."* And: *"Do not make Warwick reconcile contradictory
> counts or labels himself."*

**AC1 — "WHY ISN'T MY BASKET READY?" — ONE sentence, prominent.** His examples are the specification:
*"2 decisions still need you." · "Nothing needs you. AsdAIr is reconciling 3 products." · "Everything is
resolved. Ready to build the ASDA basket." · "Basket build failed. Nothing was ordered."*
⛔ *"Never require Warwick to infer this from several counters."*

**AC2 — ONE canonical status, rendered unambiguously:** AsdAIr working · Needs Warwick · Ready for Warwick ·
Browser working · Complete · Failed. **No second status indicator may contradict it.**

**AC3 — THIS WEEK'S SHOP, in human terms.** Source read status · source-line count · reconciled products ·
total products and items · **what came from PHOTO · ADDED FROM REGULARS · from HOUSEHOLD RULES · decided by
WARWICK · SKIPPED** · what remains unresolved · what blocks the basket.
**The summary shape Warwick wrote:** *39 from photograph + N Regulars − N skipped = N final products / N
items.* ⛔ **Never an undifferentiated database-derived blob.**

**AC4 — EXCEPTION-FIRST BY DEFAULT.** *"Warwick is NOT going to proofread 39 lines every week."* Default
emphasis: **needs attention · changes and additions · unresolved exceptions.** Resolved lines remain
available compactly/collapsed. The full photograph viewable **when wanted**, not by default.

**AC5 — THE QUESTION BOARD Warwick can answer from.** All questions still needing him · answers already
accepted · what remains · whether anything blocks the shop. Per unresolved line, where useful: **the
relevant image CROP** — *"show the relevant crop rather than making Warwick hunt around the page"* — what
AsdAIr interpreted, the proposed match, genuinely useful alternatives, and **natural free-text input**.
He must be able to: **answer in free text · choose a candidate · correct an already-resolved item · mark
"not this week" · see immediately the answer was accepted · see immediately what remains.** Where
meaningful, show **applied to this shop** vs **remembered for future shops**.
⛔ **Do not force Warwick to understand internal rule rows.**

**AC6 — RULES in human language.** *"Never automatically substitute products — applies to every shop"* ·
*"Cravendale Semi-Skimmed — usually buy 4 × 2L"* · *"Vanish stain remover — prefer Gold"*. **Only expose
edit/forget where the bounded authorised mechanism actually supports it, and do not imply CRUD that does
not exist.**

**AC7 — VERA'S THREE OUTSTANDING RESIDUALS, addressed or explicitly justified.** The 39px shared
tab-switcher primitive, the focus-trap body-bounce edge, and the Chromium focus-visible heuristic. **None is
blocking; all three must be resolved or a reasoned justification recorded.** Do not regress the six-state
colour, 44px targets, focus rings or sheet focus trap already landed.

**AC8 — RENDER-CHECK EVERY CLAIM.** ⚠️ **A UI change is not proven by a diff.** Render the surface and
verify each acceptance claim against what is actually displayed. **State which claims are render-verified
and which are code-verified only.**

⚠️ **THE BACKEND IS MOVING UNDER YOU, IN PARALLEL, RIGHT NOW.** Build against the API contract, keep the
seam explicit, and **report any assumption you make about a field name or shape** — Larry is integrating
both and a silent seam disagreement is exactly the failure to avoid. **If the backend does not yet expose
something an AC needs, build to the contract, stub it visibly, and REPORT it — do not invent a field.**
